rows.note: Use 悶 as the all-purpose choice when something is boring or monotonous.

example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 mun6

rows.note: Use 長氣 for something drawn-out and wearisome, especially speech, explanations, or procedures.

example.english: Your explanation is so tedious that even I get tired listening to it.
example.traditional: 你份解釋咁長氣，聽到我都攰。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan2 gaai2 sik1 gam3 coeng4 hei3 teng1 dou3 ngo5 dou1 gui6

rows.note: Use 花時間 when the tedious aspect is that something takes a long time to do.

example.english: Sorting through this pile of documents is tedious and takes a long time.
example.traditional: 整理呢堆文件好花時間。
example.jyutping: zing2 lei5 ne1 deoi1 man4 gin6 hou2 faa1 si4 gaan3
